consequence.statement: This is a new optional feature; existing Certificate resources using passwordSecretRef continue to work without changes.

assertion.statement: JKS and PKCS12 keystore password fields can now accept literal values as an alternative to passwordSecretRef in Certificate resources.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: evidence describes the feature as allowing literal password values but does not specify the exact field names or paths for the new password fields; artifact context only shows existing passwordSecretRef paths; change: evidence states the feature allows literal password values mutually exclusive with passwordSecretRef, but does not specify the exact field name, structure, or before/after values for the new password fields
